title: fix(plugin-list,plugin-gantt,types): toolbar Filter and chips reach the tree and chart queries; toolbar Search reaches the gantt query (objectui#10250)
body:
Fixes #10250
Clause-②: yes (widening)
## What was wrong (re-measured on `main` at `8b1f06619`, real renderers)

`ListView`'s toolbar offers Filter, the `UserFilters` chips and Search on every view, and its own fetch applies all three. Three views do not draw those rows; they run their own query from their node, and their nodes did not carry the toolbar state. A temporary probe (not committed) rendered `ListView` over the REAL registered `object-tree`, `object-chart` and `object-gantt` renderers, with toolbar `status equals open`, authored `name != zzz` and search `needle`:

| view | host fetch | the view's own query on `main` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| tree | `$filter` = `["and",[["name","!=","zzz"]],["status","=","open"]]`, `$search` = `"needle"` | `find` with `$top 2001`, `$filter` = `[["name","!=","zzz"]]`, no `$search` |
| chart (object-bound) | same | `aggregate` with `filter` = `[["name","!=","zzz"]]` |
| gantt | same | `find` with `$top 2001`, the full effective `$filter` (objectui#10037), no `$search` |

All three sites reproduce as the card describes.

## The change

- `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`
  - The objectui#10037 value is generalised from gantt to the three self-querying views and renamed `selfQueryFilter`. It is the same `buildEffectiveFilter(...)` value `ListView`'s own fetch sends, cached by its serialised payload (AGENTS.md #10), and a refused filter (`FilterOperatorError`) keeps the last value instead of widening.
  - The `tree` node and the object-bound `chart` node now carry `filter: selfQueryFilter` (the tree after the `baseProps` spread, the chart in place of `filter: schema.filter`). The dataset-bound chart shape is unchanged; see the findings below.
  - The `gantt` node also carries the toolbar term as `search` and, with a term, the view's `searchableFields`. That is the same pair `ListView`'s own fetch sends (`$search`, plus `$searchFields` when the view declares `searchableFields`). The term is held as a gantt-only primitive (`ganttSearchTerm`), so a keystroke does not rebuild other views' nodes.
- `packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx`: `reload` sends `search` as `$search` and, only alongside a term, `searchableFields` as `$searchFields`. Both reload dependency lists take the term (a string) and a serialised key for the field list, never an array identity (objectui#10036's parity pair).
- `packages/types`: `ObjectGanttSchema` declares `search?: string` and `searchableFields?: string[]` on the interface and on the zod mirror. This is why the claim carries `Clause-②: yes`: two new optional keys on a published schema. A declared key is validated, and the renderer reads both.
- Docs: the `plugin-gantt.mdx` Schema API block and the plugin README name the pair (AGENTS.md #2). These two files are outside the claim's file fence. They are the documentation of the declared keys.
- Changesets: `10250-self-querying-views-toolbar-state.md` (`@object-ui/types` minor, `@object-ui/plugin-gantt` minor, `@object-ui/plugin-list` patch). The pending `10037-gantt-toolbar-filter-reaches-chart.md` said "Every other view draws the rows `ListView` fetched" and "The gantt chart is the one view that queries for itself". Both statements were false (tree and chart query for themselves), so that paragraph is corrected here. Its other claims still hold.

### Mechanism assumptions (from the dispatch), measured

- A1 holds. On the object-bound shape, the node's `filter` is the only filter input `ObjectChart`'s aggregate reads. `ListView` writes no `dataSource` binding, `compareTo` or `drillDown` onto that node. The probe's aggregate `filter` after the fix is exactly the host's `$filter` (no double AND). `@objectstack/spec`'s `isFilterAST` accepts that shape, and `parseFilterAST` lowers it to `{"$and":[{"name":{"$ne":"zzz"}},{"status":"open"}]}`. That is the path `data-objectstack` uses to lower an array filter for `aggregate`.
- A2 holds. `ObjectTree`'s object-provider branch reads `schema.filter`, so `plugin-tree` is untouched.
- A3: the search goes through a node key, the same channel as the objectui#10037 filter. It needed two declarations in `@object-ui/types`, listed above. If the server refuses a term for an object, `ListView`'s own fetch fails inside its load `try` and the load-error panel replaces the chart. The chart's query receives the same term, so the behaviour matches `ListView`'s and no fallback was added.
- A4: `ListView`'s own fetch sends `$search` on tree and chart too, and neither view's query carries it. It is not a one-line forwarding: `ObjectTree` has no search channel (it would need a new key and a `plugin-tree` change), and the aggregate call has no search parameter at all. It is reported as a finding and not handled here.

## Tests and measurements (final head `3bd041e6a`)

- New pin `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.selfQueryingViewsToolbarState-10250.test.tsx`. Its stand-ins follow each registered renderer's query contract: the tree keys on the identity of `schema.filter` and of the host `data`; the chart keys on the serialised filter; the gantt takes only `schema`. Tree and chart each get CONTROL, FORWARDS (toolbar Filter at mount), CHANGE (a `UserFilters` toggle chip clicked after mount) and STABILITY (unrelated re-renders cause no new view query). Gantt search gets CONTROL, FORWARDS (term typed into the toolbar box), SEARCHABLE FIELDS, CLEARED and STABILITY. 13 passed.
- New pin `packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.searchTerm-10250.test.tsx`: CONTROL, TERM, FIELDS, INERT FIELDS (a field list with no term sends neither key), CHANGE, STABILITY (a new but equal node does not re-query) and INLINE (a `value` provider is narrowed by `ValueDataSource`). 7 passed.
- New pin `packages/types/src/__tests__/gantt-search-keys-10250.test.ts`: both keys are declared, optional and without defaults, wrong-typed values are refused on their path, and a `@ts-expect-error` pair is compiled by `tsconfig.test.json`. 5 passed.
- End-to-end probe with the REAL renderers after the fix (not committed; it imports packages `plugin-list` does not declare):
  - tree: own `find` `$filter` = the host's effective filter.
  - chart: aggregate `filter` = the host's effective filter.
  - gantt: own `find` carries `$search: "needle"`, and with `searchableFields: ['name']` also `$searchFields: ["name"]`, identical to the host's.
  - A chip clicked after mount changes each view's query exactly once (tree 1 then 2, chart 1 then 2).
  - Two unrelated re-renders afterwards issue no further view query.
- Reverse verification. Every mutation went through `ablation-replace.mjs`: the anchor hit once, the blob changed, and the restore was proven by blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. Tests resolve `../ListView` and `./ObjectGantt` from source, so no `dist` was involved.
  - Tree node back to `schema.filter`: 3 failed / 10 passed (tree FORWARDS, CHANGE, STABILITY).
  - Chart node back to `schema.filter`: 3 failed / 10 passed (chart FORWARDS, CHANGE, STABILITY).
  - Gantt `search` spread disabled: 4 failed / 9 passed (FORWARDS, SEARCHABLE FIELDS, CLEARED, STABILITY). CLEARED and STABILITY fail because their preconditions wait for the term.
  - Payload cache disabled: 1 failed / 12 passed. Only the tree STABILITY case fails; the chart keys on the serialised filter.
  - `reload`'s `$search` spread disabled: 5 failed / 2 passed (TERM, FIELDS, CHANGE, INLINE, STABILITY).
  - Field-list key replaced by the array identity: 1 failed / 6 passed (STABILITY).
- Type side: the dependency closure was rebuilt (`pnpm --filter '@object-ui/plugin-list^...' --filter '@object-ui/plugin-gantt^...' build`). A throwaway file assigning `search: 5` to `ObjectGanttSchema` in `plugin-gantt`'s test program failed with TS2322, which proves the rebuilt declaration was read. The file was deleted.
- Gates:
  - `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/ packages/plugin-gantt/` on `838eff69e`: 155 files / 1576 tests passed.
  - `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/` on `838eff69e`: 215 files / 4928 tests passed.
  - The commits after `838eff69e` change only the two new pins' header comments and one unused lint directive. On `3bd041e6a` the union of the three new pins, the objectui#10037 pin, `zod-mirror-parity` and the objectui#10036 reload-identity pin passed: 6 files / 72 tests.
  - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types --filter @object-ui/plugin-list --filter @object-ui/plugin-gantt type-check`: exit 0, and each new test file is in its package's `tsconfig.test.json` (`--listFilesOnly`).
  - `lint` for the same three packages: exit 0, 0 errors.
  - All exit 0 on `3bd041e6a`: `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `changeset:check`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check:changeset-claims` (report-only), `check:control-bytes`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers` / `-inherit` / `-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check-doc-links.mjs`.
  - NOT MEASURED: `check:doc-snippets` and `check:doc-examples` (PRECONDITION NOT MET, exit 2) and `check-readme-exports.mjs` (population collapse). All three need a build of about 34 packages. Both doc edits are prose or a `plaintext` fence, which none of those gates compiles. Left to CI.

## Findings outside this card (for the seat; not fixed here)

- The toolbar Search does not reach the `tree` view's own query (the probe: host `$search` present, the tree's own `find` has none).
- The toolbar Search does not reach an object-bound `chart` (the aggregate call has no search parameter).
- A `chart` view bound to a semantic `dataset`: its node carries no `filter` at all, so neither the authored filter nor the toolbar Filter and chips reach `queryDataset`. The probe's call was `["task_ds",{"dimensions":["status"],"measures":["total_estimate"]}]` with no `runtimeFilter`. This one is not a one-line forwarding: `runtimeFilter` is the spec's `FilterCondition`, and a dataset's field namespace need not be the list object's.

## Acceptance notes

- The real `ObjectTree` also keys its record effect on the host `data` identity. When a host fetch returns a fresh rows array, one toolbar change therefore gives the tree two queries with the same new filter: one when the node filter changes, one when the host rows land. Measured with the probe: after one chip click the tree queries went from 1 to 3 with fresh arrays, and from 1 to 2 with a stable array. The same dependency means a host refetch on `main` also re-queried the tree, with the authored filter. That is read from the effect's dependency list and was not measured on `main`. The duplicate comes from that pre-existing dependency in `plugin-tree` and is not changed here.
- `searchableFields` is forwarded only alongside a term, matching `ListView`'s own fetch and `ObjectGrid`. On a standalone gantt it acts only when `search` is authored.
- `react-hooks/refs` lint warnings in `ListView.tsx` go from 7 on `main` to 9 (ESLint `--format json`, same config, both files linted in one run). The five in the cache block are the objectui#10037 ones on the renamed ref. The rule also fires once per read site of the cached value: gantt before, now tree and chart too. They are warnings, and the file has 0 errors.
